name: Rocket Blast - 1g Cart - MeloMelon OG
description:
Rocket Blast 1G Cart — MeloMelon OG (510 Thread)

Sweet melon meets classic OG. The Rocket Blast MeloMelon OG cartridge holds 1 gram of premium oil — a distillate base blended with terpenes — in a universal-fit 510-thread cart that screws right onto any standard battery. Simple, reliable, and made to last.

MeloMelon OG brings a juicy, refreshing flavor: sweet ripe melon up front, grounded by earthy, piney OG notes and a smooth finish. It's a balanced, taste-forward profile that pairs bright fruit with that familiar OG backbone.

Why you'll love it:

1G total oil — premium distillate blended with terpenes for full flavor
Universal 510-thread fit — works with any standard 510 battery
Signature MeloMelon OG flavor — sweet, juicy melon with earthy OG undertones
Reliable performance — flavorful, even pulls from first to last

Big flavor and dependable quality in a classic, easy-to-use cartridge. Just attach your battery and enjoy — Rocket Blast MeloMelon OG is ready when you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
